prompt:
Find real data on how many people actively use the Omarchy Linux distribution or how many times it has been installed. Cite the sources and quote any figures.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the provided search results, there are no official figures for "active daily users" or a verified count of unique installations that excludes reinstalls and virtual machine tests. The available data focuses on ISO download counts, which the sources note likely overstate the number of retained, active users.

Here is the real data found regarding downloads and installation metrics:

SOURCE: https://omarchy.us/news/2026/08/100000-downloads-in-a-week/ | QUOTE: "One hundred thousand downloads of the Omarchy ISO in the past week!" | CLAIM: Omarchy recorded 100,000 ISO downloads in a single week in late August 2026.

SOURCE: https://omarchy.us/news/2026/09/quattro-crosses-200000-iso-downloads/ | QUOTE: "Two hundred thousand ISO downloads of Omarchy Quattro in just 18 days!" | CLAIM: The Omarchy Quattro release reached 200,000 ISO downloads within 18 days of its launch.

SOURCE: https://exa.ai/library/podcast/2fcpbmjslqh/episode/5vkwc1sslv7 | QUOTE: "The adoption numbers are the reason Daniel noticed 1,165,980 ISO downloads in year one." | CLAIM: Omarchy achieved approximately 1.16 million ISO downloads in its first year.

SOURCE: https://www.panews.io/articles/01a0855c-f312-70ef-b5d1-eb2cf87f5c1e | QUOTE: "Omarchy ISO downloads have approached nearly 10,000 per day via Cloudflare CDN..." | CLAIM: Daily download rates reached nearly 10,000 per day as of September 2026.

SOURCE: https://stealwhatworks.com/blogs/news/why-omarchy-blowing-up | QUOTE: "Omarchy's download numbers almost certainly overstate its retained user base, so 100,000 weekly downloads should never be translated into 100,000 new permanent Omarchy users." | CLAIM: Download figures are not equivalent to active user counts due to reinstalls, VM testing, and curiosity-driven trials.

SOURCE: https://stealwhatworks.com/blogs/news/why-omarchy-blowing-up | QUOTE: "Omarchy currently does not publish a clean daily-active-user or retained-install figure that would let us measure this funnel properly." | CLAIM: There is no publicly available official metric for active daily users or retained installations.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: Verified number of unique, long-term active daily users for Omarchy.
